title: Poland and Lithuania defeat the Teutonic Order
summary: A Polish and Lithuanian army under Wladyslaw II Jagiello and Vytautas defeated the Teutonic Knights at Grunwald. The Grand Master and much of the order's leadership were killed.
reason: The Teutonic Order and the Polish-Lithuanian union had long disputed Samogitia and other borderlands.
significance: It broke the power of the Teutonic Order and made Poland-Lithuania a leading power of Eastern Europe.
